title: Why Does Self-Distillation (Sometimes) Degrade the Reasoning Capability of LLMs?
abstract: arXiv:2603.24472v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Self-distillation has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for LLMs, often improving performance while shortening reasoning traces. However, in mathematical reasoning, we find that it can reduce response length while degrading performance. We trace this degradation to the suppression of epistemic verbalization - the model's expression of uncertainty during reasoning. Through controlled experiments varying conditioning context richness and task coverage, we show that conditioning the teacher on rich information suppresses uncertainty expression, enabling rapid in-domain optimization with limited task coverage but harming OOD performance, where unseen problems benefit from expressing uncertainty and adjusting accordingly. Across Qwen3-1.7B/8B, DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen-7B, and Olmo3-7B-Instruct, we observe performance drops of up to 40%. translated_title: 为什么自蒸馏有时会降低大语言模型的推理能力？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.24472v4 公告类型：替换 摘要：自蒸馏已成为大语言模型后训练的一种有效范式，通常能提升性能并缩短推理轨迹。然而，在数学推理中，我们发现它可能减少响应长度同时降低性能。我们将这种退化追溯到对认知性言语表达的抑制——即模型在推理过程中对不确定性的表达。通过控制条件上下文丰富度和任务覆盖范围的受控实验，我们表明，用丰富信息对教师模型进行条件化会抑制不确定性表达，从而实现有限任务覆盖下的快速域内优化，但损害了域外性能，因为未见问题受益于表达不确定性并相应调整。在Qwen3-1.7B/8B、DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen-7B和Olmo3-7B-Instruct上，我们观察到性能下降高达40%。我们的发现强调，暴露适当水平的不确定性对于稳健推理至关重要。
tldr: 本文发现自蒸馏通过抑制模型推理中的不确定性表达，导致数学推理性能下降，尤其在域外问题上，最多可降低40%的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that self-distillation degrades mathematical reasoning performance by suppressing epistemic verbalization of uncertainty, causing up to 40% performance drops, especially on out-of-distribution problems.
